item.lawsjustice.area_selector.tooltip: Right-click two corners to select an area.
item.lawsjustice.area_selector.tooltip.a: Sneak + right-click sets the spawn/release point above the block.
gui.lawsjustice.title: Laws & Justice
gui.lawsjustice.connection_wait: The server has not replied. Refresh the ledger to try again.
gui.lawsjustice.free_hint: There is no active prison sentence against you.
gui.lawsjustice.online_only: Only time spent online counts. Your sentence is released automatically when the remaining time reaches zero.
gui.lawsjustice.admin_hint: Build the prison yourself, survey its bounds, register its cells and use this ledger to manage sentences. Administrative access is checked on the server for every decision.
gui.lawsjustice.prisoner_hint: You may walk throughout your prison. The cell is your arrival and return point.
gui.lawsjustice.no_escape_hint: Leaving the world pauses the sentence. Death, portals and teleportation do not cancel it. You return to your cell while custody remains active.
gui.lawsjustice.selection_help: Use the Prison Surveyor on two corners. Sneak + right-click sets an anchor above the clicked block. All points must be in the same dimension.
gui.lawsjustice.prisons_hint: A prison follows the construction you build. Register the outer bounds first, then create cells inside. No structure is generated.
gui.lawsjustice.prison_anchor_help: For a prison, the anchor is the release point. Place it outside the selected prison bounds, on safe ground. Existing areas must be surveyed again before saving.
gui.lawsjustice.picker_hint:
%s of %s · %s
Click to select the next entry. Use the arrows to browse.
gui.lawsjustice.select_prison_first: Register and select a prison before configuring its cells.
gui.lawsjustice.no_cells: This prison has no cells yet.
gui.lawsjustice.cell_anchor_help: For a cell, the anchor is the arrival point. It must lie inside both the cell and the prison. Cells cannot overlap. Survey again before saving.
gui.lawsjustice.capacity_invalid: Cell capacity must be a whole number from 1 to 16.
gui.lawsjustice.sentences_hint: Version 0.1 provides administrator custody controls. Presidential judgments, warrants and handcuffs are planned for version 0.2.
gui.lawsjustice.sentence_safety: The server checks the player, prison, cell capacity and safe arrival point. Duration only advances while the player is online.
gui.lawsjustice.minutes_invalid: Duration must be a whole number from 1 to 43,200 minutes.
gui.lawsjustice.history_hint: An append-only history of sentences, completion and emergency release. The newest decisions appear first. This version does not implement criminal trials.
gui.lawsjustice.no_history: No custody decisions have been recorded.
gui.lawsjustice.server_page_hint: Browse server pages to select further prisons or view additional records.
lawsjustice.error.invalid: The request or saved data is invalid.
lawsjustice.error.coordinates: The selected coordinates are outside the supported world limits.
lawsjustice.error.dimension: All selected points must be in the same valid dimension.
lawsjustice.error.area: Select two valid corners for the area.
lawsjustice.error.area_size: The selected area is too large. Each side may be at most 1,024 blocks and its volume at most 16,777,216 blocks.
lawsjustice.error.name: Enter a name between 1 and 48 characters.
lawsjustice.error.reason: Enter a reason between 1 and 300 characters.
lawsjustice.error.capacity: The capacity is invalid or the custody register has reached its limit.
lawsjustice.error.cell_spawn: The cell arrival point must be inside the cell.
lawsjustice.error.revision: The record version is invalid. Refresh the ledger.
lawsjustice.error.release_inside: The prison release point must be outside its bounds.
lawsjustice.error.duplicate: A record with that identifier already exists.
lawsjustice.error.cell_area: The cell must be entirely inside its prison and in the same dimension.
lawsjustice.error.overlap: The selected area overlaps another registered prison or cell.
lawsjustice.error.date: The custody record has an invalid date.
lawsjustice.error.ticks: The sentence duration or time served is invalid.
lawsjustice.error.reduction: Sentence reductions are not available in version 0.1.
lawsjustice.error.action: The requested custody action is invalid.
lawsjustice.error.history: The custody history could not be validated. Ask an administrator to check the world data.
lawsjustice.error.reference: This record refers to a prison or cell that no longer exists.
lawsjustice.error.completed_active: A completed sentence cannot remain active. Refresh the ledger.
lawsjustice.error.prison_missing: The selected prison no longer exists. Refresh the ledger.
lawsjustice.error.cell_missing: The selected cell no longer exists. Refresh the ledger.
lawsjustice.error.cell_full: This cell is full. Select another cell or increase its capacity before sentencing.
lawsjustice.error.stale: The ledger has changed. Review the refreshed information and try again.
lawsjustice.error.already_sentenced: This player already has an active sentence.
lawsjustice.error.sentence: The sentence could not be validated.
lawsjustice.error.prison_active: This prison or cell has active sentences and cannot be changed or removed.
lawsjustice.error.sentence_missing: This player no longer has an active sentence.
lawsjustice.error.thread: The custody action must run on the server thread.
lawsjustice.error.permission: Only an administrator may authorize custody decisions in version 0.1.
lawsjustice.error.selection: Select both corners and an anchor with the Prison Surveyor in this dimension.
lawsjustice.error.session: The physical prison ledger is no longer within reach. Open it again at a control block.
lawsjustice.error.request: This request is invalid. Refresh the ledger and check the selected fields.
lawsjustice.error.release_point: Select a safe release point outside the prison, with solid ground and room for the player.
lawsjustice.error.player_offline: The selected player must be online, alive and outside spectator mode.
lawsjustice.error.storage: The custody data could not be safely saved. Ask an administrator to check the world storage.
lawsjustice.error.data: The saved custody data failed validation. Restore a valid world backup before using justice.
lawsjustice.notification.title: Royal custody
lawsjustice.notification.sentenced: You have been sentenced to prison. Your sentence counts only while you are online.
lawsjustice.notification.released: You have been released. You are free to leave.
lawsjustice.message.saved: The custody register has been saved.
lawsjustice.message.sentenced: The sentence was recorded and the player was sent to the cell.
lawsjustice.command.help: Use the physical Prison Control or Reinforced Lock to open the custody ledger. Administrators can use /justice blocks to obtain the building tools.
gui.lawsjustice.court.title: Royal Court
gui.lawsjustice.court.subtitle: LAW · TESTIMONY · THE PRESIDENT’S SEAL
gui.lawsjustice.court.president_live: Judicial authority requires a current, sworn mandate.
gui.lawsjustice.court.citizen_rights: File accusations and submit testimony in your cases.
gui.lawsjustice.court.no_cases: No matching cases on this page.
gui.lawsjustice.court.file_hint: Describe what happened and identify the accused. Filing an accusation is not a conviction. The President reviews the case and its evidence.
gui.lawsjustice.court.select_case: Select a case from the register first.
gui.lawsjustice.court.no_evidence: No evidence has been submitted in this case.
gui.lawsjustice.court.evidence_hint: Your text, name and date are permanently appended to this case. Up to 16 statements may be submitted before the verdict.
gui.lawsjustice.court.case_resolved: The case has been decided. New evidence can no longer be submitted.
gui.lawsjustice.court.hearing_hint: Review the accusation and the Evidence tab. Open a hearing before recording a verdict. The server checks your current authority for every decision.
gui.lawsjustice.court.verdict_hint: Verdicts cannot be applied twice. The case and prison sentence are committed together. Prison time counts only while the player is online.
gui.lawsjustice.court.hearing_required: A hearing must be open before either verdict can be recorded.
gui.lawsjustice.court.no_warrants: No warrants are visible to you on this page.
gui.lawsjustice.court.hours_invalid: Validity must be a whole number between 1 and 168 hours.
gui.lawsjustice.court.warrant_help: The document is delivered as a physical parchment. Use it to inspect the authoritative record. To apply handcuffs, carry a valid warrant for that player and stand within three blocks.
gui.lawsjustice.court.warrant_limit: A warrant authorizes one temporary arrest, for at most five minutes. It does not create a prison sentence. Copies cannot authorize another arrest after execution.
gui.lawsjustice.court.document_accused: By order of the court, the named accused is:
gui.lawsjustice.court.document_valid: This warrant is currently valid for one arrest.
gui.lawsjustice.court.document_invalid: This document does not currently authorize an arrest.
item.lawsjustice.handcuffs.tooltip: Use on a player while carrying their valid warrant.
item.lawsjustice.handcuffs.tooltip.relea: Sneak + use to release, when authorized.
item.lawsjustice.warrant.tooltip: Use to inspect the server-validated warrant.
lawsjustice.error.council_unavailable: Realm Council could not be read safely. Judicial decisions are suspended until its data is available.
gui.lawsjustice.court.convict_reason_lim: A prison verdict must have at most 300 characters. Acquittals allow up to 800.
lawsjustice.error.already_imprisoned: This player is already serving a prison sentence.
lawsjustice.error.case_hearing: This case already has a hearing.
lawsjustice.error.case_missing: The case is unavailable or you cannot access it.
lawsjustice.error.case_reference: The warrant must refer to a case for the same accused player.
lawsjustice.error.case_resolved: This case already has a final verdict.
lawsjustice.error.case_state: The case contains an invalid decision or sentence reference.
lawsjustice.error.court_authority: Only the current, sworn President may decide. Administrators retain emergency access.
lawsjustice.error.handcuffs_required: Hold the handcuffs in your main hand.
lawsjustice.error.hearing_required: Open a hearing before recording a verdict.
lawsjustice.error.restraint_duration: A temporary arrest must remain within the warrant validity and five-minute limit.
lawsjustice.error.restraint_release: Only the escort or an emergency administrator may remove these handcuffs.
lawsjustice.error.restraint_source: You cannot detain another player while imprisoned or handcuffed.
lawsjustice.error.restraint_target: Stand within three blocks of another living player in the same dimension.
lawsjustice.error.warrant_duration: A warrant must be valid for between one and 168 hours.
lawsjustice.error.warrant_inactive: This warrant no longer authorizes an arrest.
lawsjustice.error.warrant_invalid: Carry a valid, server-issued warrant naming this player.
lawsjustice.error.warrant_missing: The server has no record of this warrant.
lawsjustice.error.warrant_reference: The arrest does not match its recorded warrant.
lawsjustice.error.evidence: Testimony must contain between one and 1,200 characters.
lawsjustice.error.accusation: An accusation must contain between one and 800 characters.
lawsjustice.error.verdict: Record a reasoned verdict within the character limit.
lawsjustice.message.case_filed: Accusation filed. The court must review the case before deciding.
lawsjustice.message.court_decided: The verdict and prison sentence have been saved together.
lawsjustice.message.evidence_saved: Testimony saved with your name and date.
lawsjustice.message.warrant_copied: Copy issued. All copies share the same single arrest authorization.
lawsjustice.notification.cuffed: You have been handcuffed under a valid arrest warrant.
